access_note: Model source is free; the current repository states that running the current Vensim version requires licensed DSS or PRO. Earlier versions can use Vensim PLE.
description: FeliX is a system-dynamics integrated-assessment model of global social, economic and environmental interactions. IIASA and partner researchers provide Vensim model versions connecting population, energy, land and food with climate and behavioural change. The archived Model Master release is freely accessible on Zenodo under MIT terms; the current GitHub repository instead states GPL-3.0, so licence choice must follow the release obtained. Current repository instructions say simulation requires Vensim DSS or PRO, while packaged models can be displayed with Model Reader. Thus free model access does not imply a free runtime for every version. Global aggregation limits site-level infrastructure interpretation, and scenario outcomes depend on assumptions. The code was not executed. No directly related catalogue model was identified.
